description: This file implements an authentication service handling API-key and OAuth flows, including functions to validate API keys, initiate OAuth authorization, and complete OAuth callback by exchanging authorization codes for tokens and storing them.

methods.name: str handle_api_key_auth(tenant_id: str, provider: str, api_key: str, label: Optional[str])
methods.description: Validates the provided API key with the provider, then stores the token, returning the token ID.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] initiate_oauth(tenant_id: str, provider: str, redirect_base: str, redirect_path: str, scope: Optional[List[str]], state: Optional[str])
methods.description: Constructs an OAuth authorization URL with appropriate redirect URI, scope, and state, returning both the URL and state.

methods.name: str complete_oauth_callback(tenant_id: str, provider: str, code: str, redirect_base: str, redirect_path: str, state: str)
methods.description: Exchanges the authorization code for an access token, then stores it along with OAuth metadata, returning the token ID.
